The research introduces a comprehensive empirical study evaluating the security vulnerabilities of small language models (SLMs) against jailbreak attacks, providing insights into their susceptibility and proposing effective defense mechanisms.

- **Empirical Evaluation**: Tested 13 state-of-the-art SLMs under various jailbreak attacks.
